name: Mildex Optical Inc.
summary: Mildex Optical Inc. manufactures and trades in touch panels and other products in Taiwan. It offers large size touch screens; traditional resistive touch screens; projective capacitive touch screens; resistive multi-touch screens; and sunlight readable touch screens for use in patient check-in Kiosk, diagnostic apparatus, industrial panel PC, automation equipment, smart monitoring system, IOT applications, imaging display system, ventilator/respirator, robotic surgery arm, patient monitoring system, fighter jets command system, handheld controller, rugged laptop, military vehicle/tank, treadmill, smart monitoring system, smart electronic, and self-service Kiosk applications. The company also provides touch display module. Mildex Optical Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
